C1056.title: Two Men in Dushan Sentenced for Setting Up Communication Devices to Facilitate Telecom Fraud
C1056.summary: He Moumou and Luo Moumou used personal phones, phone cards and audio adapter cables in dormitories and hotels to set up communication equipment for upstream fraud callers and keep the lines available. The 23 phone cards they provided led to 10 victims losing 514,300 yuan, while the pair illegally earned more than 35,000 yuan and were ultimately convicted of aiding information network criminal activity.
